statement: Dolphin ControllerInterface only applies gyro from MotionPlus reports after a 32-byte A40020 read has supplied MotionPlus fast/slow calibration; it parses the six-byte MP portion in report 0x37 and requires a known active mode. The 32-byte calibration has a CRC warning path that does not itself reject the parsed block. IR configuration writes sensitivity blocks to B00000/9 and B0001A/2, selects B00033 basic mode and B00030 tracking, and must finish before extension tasks. A standalone F2 calibration-trigger function exists but is not called from RunTasks or other inspected ControllerInterface call sites; it is not a mandatory pre-gyro gate in this pinned path. Lack of current verified timing, read-handler and mapping stability remains a separate question.
